**Finding: RENEWAL — compliant (preferred level).**

- **Investigation:** Checked planner candidates (p0582, p0300, p0043), read all of Article 12, resolved "Royalty Term" (p0227), and ran targeted searches for "renew/renewal/evergreen/successive", "extension of the Term", and "price increase". The only "renewals" hit is p0138, which concerns Regulatory Approval filings, not contract term.
- **Result:** The Agreement is a milestone/royalty licence with an evergreen-to-royalty-expiry Term (12.1.1). There is no automatic renewal, no renewal term length, no non-renewal notice window, and no price-escalation mechanic, so every conditional element of the checklist is inapplicable.
- **Preferred element 1 met:** any extension must be a mutual signed amendment under 13.9 ("No amendment, modification, release, or discharge ... unless in writing and duly executed by authorized representatives of both Parties").
- **Favourable to us:** 12.1.2 converts the Section 5.1.3 grants to non-exclusive, fully-paid, royalty-free and irrevocable on natural expiry — no post-expiry re-pricing exposure. No redline proposed.
